description: The sandbox only (`network: "testnet"`): returns a checkout link for play money, for the person to open; it lands in this key's account within a minute. Never open it yourself. On the real network (`network: "mainnet"`) nothing tops up an account: money goes on asks, and a card pays one when it is posted (post_ask or post_call with pay_by "card").

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

pay.description: How much play money, in dollars: 10, 25 or 100. Default 10. The sandbox only.

name: top_up
title: Get play money (sandbox)
